scope: Actual unchanged S16KiB and V RTL on one simulation clock; finite public-port benchmark controller. Operands come from S response holding register, EXP results overwrite same S addresses before denominator/global replay barriers. Independent expected arrays only check results and never feed post-initialization operands. Initial S writes, actual payload transactions/acks, simultaneous S/V requests, stalls and final consume counted. No extra payload queue or additional 6KiB/16KiB storage. Control/address/mux implementation and S/V interconnect P&R/timing are not qualified; this is block-level schedule/traffic evidence, not a system performance claim.
